<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty have declined for seven consecutive weeks, pressured by rising bond yields and crude oil prices exceeding $105 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNWXljS2lJMkFpaml6eFlpbWlabVU3cURURE5TZnduZG11ZGpuV2JfZ3A4S25XTmJESGdXalhNdzdmcnB2YVNQbElVZTVLU3Z3Ykh1ZHVwb0ZfYURYbXV6dnp2Rl9UR1AyNnppM0FMYnRacWFxcXFNSjN6UC13Y0ZtYVhkaFI5YWc5VGhBYVdXSTV5cWVETzJIS0d3RXZnOXlldE9pUy1yWVg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional Flows:</strong> Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net sellers for the sixth straight week, offloading ₹11,490 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) provided support with net purchases of ₹16,398 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic Indicators:</strong> While the RBI reports a robust 7.8% GDP growth, forex reserves have contracted by $14.9 billion, and the rupee is expected to trade in the ₹94.5–96 range due to insufficient dollar inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOMHV0dGdZVXhqbVhQZnk3TFdCVzRIT0YtWHkxWTd3LTI5YmlNb1dhaHRoSkxJSWwyQU9BRVJOS2F2VWFpOXktYUQwZHkzTjlybmFhVDlTbEtVMmRWdTdQY1pJbXpPSFdNUmZWNDFYVnNPWDZpZGFaUklGc1ZHeHZOa2ppQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Global Market Sentiment:</strong> Investors are balancing optimism regarding the Federal Reserve’s hawkish stance on inflation against persistent concerns over high crude oil prices and risks associated with AI-sector valuations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>U.S. Yield Environment:</strong> U.S. bond yields have reached 20-year highs, a development that continues to influence global liquidity and exert upward pressure on Indian bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
</ul>
